origin.dataset: U.S. International Trade in Goods and Services (FT-900, with the Census Bureau)

migration.note: The monthly balance is the FT-900 release, which the Bureau compiles with the Census Bureau. The Bureau's API does not carry it (checked in M15: its international accounts are quarterly and annual), so this stays a draft until the Census files are read (M16). The quarterly balance from the international transactions accounts is trade_q.
